name: Greater Vital Spark
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 3.5-block radius for 12 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 2.5 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 70: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 6 targets in a row, jumps up to 5 blocks, 2.5 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Heals 2 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 8 s
• Growth: up to 4 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
self_description:

• Damage 2.5 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
